_about: Building blocks for the idea generator. Each feature names what it adds, which kinds of project it suits, tags that match generator answers, pinned archive repos, and a search query so newer archive repos surface too. Add freely.

features.name: Three.js scene

features.hook: everything renders live in the browser in full 3D

features.hook: it ships as a small native game you download
